nodes.label: DetectorProcess (shared ONNX model process)
nodes.rationale: One detector process serves every camera routed to it. The model loads once; N CameraTracker processes share one detection_queue and time-share the accelerator FIFO.

nodes.label: RecordingMaintainer thread
nodes.rationale: Recording and detection are correlated by timestamp only. No handshake -- the recording maintainer buffers published per-frame activity and matches it against each cache segment's time range when deciding retention.

nodes.label: SHM frame ring (shared memory)
nodes.rationale: Pixel data never crosses a queue. Frames move capture to tracker via shared memory; tensors move tracker to detector the same way. Queues only ever carry a camera name, a timestamp, or a zero-payload "done" signal.
